messages:
maria: ACME pinged — they want a p99 tail SLA for Dedicated pools. Their workload has lots of short-lived prefixes; cold KV/prefix misses drive p99s up during bursts. sales wants a firm yes/no before we promise.
ashok: runtime perspective: we can mitigate with prewarmed micro-nodes + cache-retention on scale-in. Trade-offs: extra GPU-hours and more complex autoscaler semantics.
emily: to be concrete: we need an autoscaler drain window and 'retain-cache-on-drain' mode. Otherwise scale-in will evict warmed state immediately. Also need per-pool cache_warmth metrics.
jonathan: MVP config suggestion: enable_prewarm=true, prewarm_count=2, scale_in_retention_secs=600, cache_warmth_threshold=0.6. Pilot with those numbers and iterate.
ashok: implementation notes: add node lifecycle states: PREWARMING, WARM_ACTIVE, DRAIN_RETAIN. Persist prewarm annotation in pool config. Metric: cache_warmth = hot_keys/total_keys.
emily: ops checklist: dashboard panels for p50/p95/p99 by route, prewarm_node_util, cache_warmth, alert if cache_warmth<0.5 for >5m, alert if prewarm_failures>3 in 10m. Add rollback: flip enable_prewarm=false + force-evict if regress.
sales_amy: ACME will pay pilot uplift but asks for acceptance criteria. Can we propose measurable gates?
cust-success-ben: pilot proposal: 2 weeks on ACME tenant. Phase A shadow traffic, Phase B 10% live cutover. Acceptance gates: 1) p99 latency <250ms for 95% of invocations during pilot; 2) p99 spikes >500ms no more than 1/day; 3) monthly cost uplift <=12%.
finance_lucy: finance needs expected GPU-hours delta and a simple cost model to sign off pricing uplift. engineering to provide perf sims.
maria: rollout stages: internal lab (synthetic bursts), customer pilot (ACME), beta (select customers), GA with SKU and SLA. Each stage must pass latency + cost + observability gates.
jonathan: I'll draft the pilot telemetry queries and perf harness. Need a customer traffic replay tool and a chaos job to inject cold-cache events.
ashok: infra changes ticketed. Will add scale_in_retention flag to autoscaler, prewarm annotations, and cache_warmth metric. Also need a small DB migration for pool annotations.
deploy-bot: infra ticket created: #INFRA-8580 (prewarm annotations + autoscaler retention flag).
maria: action items: @ashok write RFC with options + perf sim by EOD Friday; @emily craft ops runbook + dashboards; @jonathan pilot acceptance doc + queries; @sales_amy confirm ACME pilot commitment; @finance_lucy model pricing once eng provides GPU-hour delta. I'll schedule kickoff Tue 10am. :+1:
